text:
三页复验，本轮把数据提到标题：
1. 第 5 页右栏第一组数字由「19 / 个上游抽换件」改为「20 / 条抽换件 · 19 文件」，检查标签是否放得下、不压下一组。
2. 第 11 页右侧四个条目标题改为数据：「31,965 s / 68 轮」「4 类 × 5 轮」「128 MiB」「41 组」，正文相应缩短；检查标题是否溢出、四条是否等距、正文不压分隔线。
3. 第 13 页底部说明改为「固件 3.17 MB / 4 MB 槽 · 35 屏 · 29 个场景 · 144 篇文档；一条命令复跑。」，检查单行是否放得下、不压页码。

PNG：/home/jinsc/SDK/vela/ppt/.build/render18/s-05.png、s-11.png、s-13.png

每页一行 JSON：{"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体到元素与位置"],"fix":""}，最后一句说明。

thinking:
Let me review the three pages as assigned. I need to read the three PNG images one by one and give verdicts.

The user gave specific checks:
1. Page 5 (s-05.png): right column first group numbers changed to 「20 / 条抽换件 · 19 文件」, check label fits, doesn't press next group.
2. Page 11 (s-11.png): right side four entry titles changed to data: 「31,965 s / 68 轮」「4 类 × 5 轮」「128 MiB」「41 组」, body text shortened; check titles don't overflow, four entries evenly spaced, body doesn't press separator lines.
3. Page 13 (s-13.png): bottom note changed to 「固件 3.17 MB / 4 MB 槽 · 35 屏 · 29 个场景 · 144 篇文档；一条命令复跑。」, check single line fits, doesn't press page number.

Output format per user: {"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体到元素与位置"],"fix":""}, one line per page, plus a final sentence explanation.

Let me read the images.

Page 5 review. The right column first group now shows "20" with label "条抽换件 · 19 文件" — that matches the requested change from 「19 / 个上游抽换件」 to 「20 / 条抽换件 · 19 文件」.

Check: label "条抽换件 · 19 文件" fits on one line below the "20", doesn't press the next group ("6 份上游补丁" group is below, separated by a divider line). Looks fine — label sits on one line, there's clear space before the divider. The subtitle at top also shows "板级改动: 20 条抽换件 / 19 文件" consistent.

Wait — the requested change said "由「19 / 个上游抽换件」改为「20 / 条抽换件 · 19 文件」". The rendered shows 20 / 条抽换件 · 19 文件. Good. Label fits on single line, doesn't overlap. No collision.

Also check other layout aspects on the page: rows look clean, no overlap. The dark openvela row — text "NuttX 内核 · VFS / LittleFS · 蓝牙栈 · USB" appears slightly tight against the dark box bottom? Looks OK. Bottom note "板级与驱动: 404 个文件 / 27.6 万行; AI 参与驱动、地图管线与测试。" fine. Page number 05 / 15.

Verdict: pass.

Page 11 review. Right side has four entries with data-as-title:
1. "31,965 s / 68 轮" + body "长稳与日志: clip / stop feed / DVFS / BT RX 停顿均为 0; diag 只收 WARN+, 500 ms 落 SD。"
2. "4 类 × 5 轮" + body "故障注入: CPS 断连、GATT 全断、GNSS 断电、三者同时，全部恢复。"
3. "128 MiB" + body "coredump: 2 KB 日志环随 dump 写出; ELF 归档可解到行号。"
4. "41 组" + body "真机取证: 摄像头录屏 + 串口日志，室外不接电脑也能留证。"

Check titles overflow: none of them appear truncated or overflowing the column; they fit on one line each. Four entries evenly spaced: dividers at approximately equal intervals — spacing looks even (divider lines between entries at consistent gaps). Body text doesn't press separator lines: there is clear gap between body text and next divider in each case.

Wait, entry 1's body text is long: "长稳与日志: clip / stop feed / DVFS / BT RX 停顿均为 0; diag 只收 WARN+, 500 ms 落 SD。" — extends to the right edge. Does it cross the right margin? It ends with "。" near the right edge, roughly aligned with the divider's right end. It seems within bounds, though close to the divider right edge. Not overlapping the divider.

Spacing between entries: divider 1 at ~250px, entry title ~293, body ~350, divider 2 at ~425, title2 ~465, body2 ~520, divider3 ~600, title3 ~637, body3 ~695, divider4 ~770, title4 ~810, body4 ~870. Roughly even. Gaps look consistent.

No issues. Verdict: pass.

Page 13 review. Bottom note now reads 「固件 3.17 MB / 4 MB 槽 · 35 屏 · 29 个场景 · 144 篇文档；一条命令复跑。」 — matches requested text. It's on a single line, located at left, and the page number "13 / 15" is at bottom right, well to the right of the note — no overlap/pressing.

The middle note line "自研部分 Apache-2.0; 地图数据按 ODbL 署名; 上游改动随仓库提交，不宣称已合入。" is above the bottom note, separated. Layout looks fine. Three columns at top balanced — right column has three lines, left/mid two lines each; slight whitespace below left columns but this is consistent design (columns top-aligned). Acceptable.

Verdict: pass for all three.

Output format per dispatch: {"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体到元素与位置"],"fix":""} — one line per page, then a final explanatory sentence.
